default_frame: Fit the existing Census place points for Mobile AL, Tallahassee FL and Dothan AL. Explicit market sets retain their own fit. Filters and refresh preserve the camera.

geometry.precision: 1:500,000 cartographic outline, clipped to lon -94..-77 and lat 23.5..37.5, simplified 0.0015 degrees for territory states and 0.01 for context states, coordinates rounded to 4 decimals, polygons under 0.00002 square degrees dropped
geometry.roles: territory: Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Mississippi painted as land. context: neighbouring states painted as muted land. The background is water, so only the Gulf and Atlantic read as sea.
geometry.rights: US Census public data; attribution displayed

market_locations.precision: place representative point, never a lead address

unknown_market: Retained in the board and map member list with No location; never guessed, geocoded or placed at 0,0. Missing, malformed and ambiguous market points are unlocated.
membership: Exact canonical lead IDs and counts from the current search, owner, stage and market filters; marker members plus no-location members equal the board.
selection: One selected lead ID highlights its board card, map member and containing market marker; retain it through matching filters and clear it when excluded. A city group or terminal cluster exposes every member in a bounded map chooser. Opening a record preserves camera and closing restores the member focus. Census place groups never offer entrance navigation.
preview: Hover or focus a marker to see its current count, place context and up to three lead titles. Escape dismisses without moving focus. Activation keeps the existing zoom, chooser and record behavior.
precision: Market area only. Census place points never claim lead-address coordinates.
phone_stage: All stages shows all filtered lanes; both stage selectors apply the same filter.
